en.text: The dollar reconfirmed its breakout this week and gave back almost nothing into the close, sitting above both short averages — the condition the whole metals complex keeps failing under.

Bonds handed back yesterday's reversal: the long bond closed red again on better than one and a half times average turnover, more than 4 ATR under its 50-day. The read on it is an intraday rejection, so whether it continues from here is the part that matters.

The ten-year prices what the real economy borrows at and it is the leg that has not turned, nearly 5 ATR under its 50-day on close to twice its usual turnover. Equities broke out with that in the background.

Gold and silver were turned back at their short averages and closed red while the miners closed green, both metals now 3% and 4.5% under their 21-day. With the dollar printing here, nothing in the complex has produced a level worth paying for.

Crude held more than 7% over its 50-day on a red session, the futures slightly green against the fund's red — a tracking gap. Natural gas took its 50-day back on nearly twice average turnover and led the industry funds.

Bitcoin reversed out of a failed attempt at new highs and closed back inside its pivot, ether alongside it, both still more than 13% over their 50-day. The equity proxies turned Lagging, which is the half to watch.

zh.text: 美元本周再次确认突破，收盘几乎没有回吐，站在两条短均线上方——这正是整个金属板块一直过不去的那个条件。
债券把前一天的反转交还了：长债在超过平时一倍半的成交量下再收红，距 50 日线超过 4 个 ATR。挂在它上面的读法是日内图上的一次拒绝，所以从这里会不会继续走，才是要紧的那一半。
十年期定的是实体经济的借贷成本，而它是还没有转的那一条腿：中期债券基金距 50 日线接近 5 个 ATR，成交量接近平时的两倍。股票是在这个背景下突破的。
黄金与白银都在短均线上被挡回并收红，矿业股反而收涨，两个金属分别处在 21 日线下方 3% 与 4.5%。美元停在现在这个位置，金属里就没有一个值得付钱的位置。
原油在收红的一天仍守在 50 日线上方 7% 以上，期货小幅收涨而基金小幅收跌，这是跟踪误差。天然气以接近平时两倍的成交量收复 50 日线，领先全部行业基金。
比特币从一次失败的新高尝试里反转，收回到它的中枢里面，以太同行，两者距 50 日线仍有 13% 以上。股票替代品当天转为 Lagging，这是更该看的那一半。
